Mitsui & Co., Ltd. is one of the leading trading and investment companies with 120 offices in 62 countries. Within a worldwide network, our skilled employees focus on customer-oriented solutions.
Mitsui & Co. Deutschland GmbH is mainly active in the fields of chemicals/plastics, infrastructure/machinery, steel, information technology and logistics.

In our 1st Basic Chemicals Department (DUSCC) we would like to fill a vacancy soonest possible:

Sales Manager (m/f/d)

Full time 38,5 hours/week – permanent employment

Your tasks:

- Marketing and sales in the petrochemicals/basic chemicals (commodities)
- Independently developing new sales markets in Europe and implementing sales strategies
- Acquiring new customers
- Managing our existing customers and business relationships
- Market research and analysis
- Price and contract negotiations
- Credit risk management
- Supporting the General Manager (direct reporting line)
- Collaboration with Mitsui offices worldwide
- On-site collaboration with the back-office team
- Contributing to the further development of our internal processing procedures
- Travelling (ard. 30%) to support business development, particularly in Europe and, where required, worldwide

Your qualifications:

- A successfully completed degree in business administration and/or a degree in chemical industry management
- Sales experience in an internationally operating company is desirable
- Knowledge of the petrochemical sector is an advantage but not essential
- Sales affinity combined with a communicative, dynamic and target oriented performance
- A high degree of initiative, commitment, and intellectual curiosity
- Readiness of mind, analytical skills as well as a structured working style
- Proficiency in both, written and spoken German and English
- Enjoy working in an international and diverse team
- Class B / 3 driving licence
- Flexibility and team spirit

Your Benefits at Mitsui:

- Flexible working hours (38.5-hour week)
- Remote work up to 2 days per week
- 30 days of annual leave
- Attractive training and development opportunities
- Company pension scheme and capital-forming benefits
- Holiday and Christmas bonuses
- Mobility subsidies (e.g., public transport)
- Bike leasing (JobRad)
- Discounted fitness programs and employee perks
- Regular team events and company functions

Contact:

We look forward to receiving your application in English. Please include your salary expectations and earliest possible start date and email it to: RecruitingDUSAJ@mitsui.com

Who We AreApplied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips - the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world - like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.

You'll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible-while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

Applied Materials is the leader in semiconductor materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality.

We are looking for a Software (Technical) Support Engineer to join the team in Dresden, Germany in support of our PDC based inspection tools.
Your key responsibilities as a Software (Technical) Support Engineer:

Software System Troubleshooting  - analyze reported problems & validate solutions, provide troubleshooting plans to discover root cause to deliver rapid resolution on systemic issues ( Microsoft Server / Network Topology / Applications )

Software Installation & Imaging  - Install & configure software & images on Early Learning Shipments (ELS) / New product Introductions (NPI) / First In Fab tools (FIF), document & perform first of kind installs on High Volume Manufacturing tools (HVM), develop & train on Software procedures

Software Test & Validation  - Collect & incorporate customer specific test scenarios, construct simulators for testing & troubleshooting, execute test plans to validate software releases (test suit)

Create, test, and verify installation/upgrade instructions  for Applied Materials' product releases.

Understand, research, and resolve internal and external application and systems issues, investigate in customer's high value problem (HVP), systematic bugs or systematic software failures.

Customer Engagement & Training - Foster customer trust in Applied Materials Software, consult on Factory Automation scenarios (FA), resolve questions on tool operations & settings

Provide on-going training to customers and customer engineers (CE) for technical products and systems issues.

Assist in analysis of customer OS performance, integration, and database management issues. Deliver updates and reports to managers, partners, and peers.

A degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation or related
2-4 years of professional experience in software testing, test cases, documentation, and network technology is preferred
Strong communication skills in English, with German being beneficial as well
A team player with a willingness to work in multi-disciplinary teams
Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations
Excellent analytical and organizational skills
Willing to do business trips to customer in Europe and to the headquarters in the US, up to 50%
Salary:

€60,000.00 - €82,500.00 What you can expect from us:

Onboarding with industry experts from the Applied Materials global team and a local buddy.

Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an
Area Manager
, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity. The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock. Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions. m/w/d Promote a culture of safety and wellbeingAnalyse and implement corrective actions to make sure quality and productivity are at consistently high levels, and business objectives are met across all shifts Support and lead a team and handle administrative work alongside building and supporting a strong team culture Analyse performance and suggest process improvements to optimise work and improve customer service Collaborate with other managers to standardise shift processe A day in the life You’ll work shifts and be based at one of our operational sites. Your main focus will be to maintain safety standards within your team and across your site. You’ll also monitor and maintain process efficiency. Your days will always include prioritising routine team management and daily operational tasks, alongside other tasks like individual escalations, process improvement work and wide-scale operational contingency planning. Being a key part of the operations team involves working with colleagues in other teams and external partners to make sure we stay on track to meet our customer demands and targets. This will involve analysing data and performance metrics with leaders in your business area, as well as discussing the operational pros and cons of technical improvements with engineers. - Experience leading and managing a team - Experience working with multiple groups of stakeholders - Bachelor's degree or above - Fluency, both written and spoken, in two of the following languages: English, German, Arabic - Experience in warehouse operations and logistics or equivalent - Experience with MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) - Current studies or a recently obtained Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in logistics, business administration/economics, engineering, or a comparable field of study Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range - delivered quickly and affordably. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience with data analysis

Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We work together to ensure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time. Across Europe we have more than 50 Fulfillment Centers, hundreds of Delivery Stations, thousands of machines, and tens of thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time. Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network. m/w/d - Lead the team, own the annual reporting responsibilities, and mentor your direct reports to develop the technicians within the team.

- Work with the site Safety department & Site Leadership to implement, record and audit safety and statutory compliance programs to provide a safe working environment for all staff. Own the legal responsibilities as the site engineering lead within this framework.
- Collaborate with the recruitment team to ensure allocated headcount is filled with high quality experienced staff. - Implement standards validated by the EU Engineering team and participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance safety and equipment availability for our internal customers, with a key focus on preventative maintenance programs.
- Maintain equipment failure contingency plans, coordinate rehearsals with affected stakeholder and be prepared to work in a flexible manner to ensure failures or breakdowns are rectified as quickly as possible.
- Maintain a long-term focus by working with Site Management, Finance, the EU Engineering team and internal design teams to plan for future growth, upgrades or new equipment roll outs.

A day in the life
We are looking for motivated, customer-focused people who want to join our team as a Reliability Maintenance Engineering Manager. You will be the site lead for all Engineering matters within a building, responsible for leading their team and building a culture of safety; for ensuring all statutory compliance requirements are followed to provide a safe working environment for all occupants of the building and for working with the EU Engineering team to plan for future growth. You are also required to participate in network-wide improvement initiatives and implement standards created elsewhere in the network. As the RME Manager, you will be a key member of the wider RME team, responsible for ensuring that our equipment and systems operate safely, efficiently, and with minimal downtime. You will lead a team of experienced professionals and collaborate with cross-functional teams across your network to optimize equipment performance and reduce costs. - Relevant experience of Engineering team leadership.

- A degree in a technical discipline (Industrial, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil) from an accredited university or equivalent experience.
- Multi skilled in both electrical and mechanical disciplines.
- Ability to communicate (written & verbal) in English and the local language.
- Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems.
- Demonstrated experience in project management.
- Comprehensive knowledge of specialized engineering and facilities equipment within the Fulfillment Center, as well as maintenance and safety procedures.
- Experience working with PLC based control systems.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.
The Position
Join our dynamic team at Boehringer Ingelheim as a Customer Experience (CX) Head, TA. In this pivotal role, you will be the strategic linchpin, leveraging data to enrich decision-making and uncovering new business opportunities within the TA. Working in close collaboration with the TA Head and a standing member of the Brand Team, you will drive customer-centric initiatives for Human Pharma Germany. If you're passionate about shaping customer experiences and have a knack for strategic thinking, we'd love to hear from you.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As the primary point of contact, you will engage with the TA Head and Brand Team, acting as a strategic sparring partner.
- You will be responsible for converting strategic and high-level tactical features into smaller, actionable user stories.
- Strong capabilities for business case and LRR development by evaluating on-going operational requirement against existing resource and capabilities
- Integral analytical support for OL, ACV and LTF planning process and preparations on a strategic level
- Involvement in business cases and LRR development will be a key part of your role, as you evaluate ongoing operational requirements against existing resources and capabilities.
- Overall management and leadership of 4-6 direct reports (incl people development) for the functional areas related to Project Management, Training & Development, Customer Insights & Forecasting, and Sales Force Effectiveness.
- Establishing strategic and cooperative relationships with various functions within HP Business Operations and cross-functional teams will be a major part of your role.
- You will serve as a liaison between various functions and groups (Brand Team, HP Operations Group Heads and Squad Leads), influencing stakeholders to improve productivity, manage necessary changes, and support key business projects.
- Direct reporting line to Head of Human Pharma Operations, Human Pharma Germany.

Requirements

- Doctoral degree (e.g., PhD, MD) and/or a Master's degree (e.g., MBA, MSc) or diploma degree
- Possess experience in a leadership or people manager role, including in-depth knowledge of the German human pharmaceutical market
- Exhibit excellent relationship-building skills and conflict management with above-average oral, written, and presentation skills
- Demonstrate the ability to drive change, manage organizational transformations, and proactively implement innovation
- Have experience in Commercial (Sales and/or Marketing), Training, Business Analyst roles.
- Possess the ability to lead and steer different functions and can lead without authority within a TAs
- Be capable of simplifying complex topics and providing clear actionable next steps.
- Exhibit strength in being a solution-driven leader to address issues/challenges and lead the team to move forward together
- Possess strong people management skills - inspires and develops growth for team members

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until 18.09.2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to 11.09.2026 are guaranteed to be considered.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from mid of September
Step 3: On-site interviews beginning of October
Please submit your application documents in English.

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge technology? At LIDROTEC, a dynamically growing company on its way to becoming an established industry player, you can do just that!

LIDROTEC has developed an innovative laser process for cutting microchips, which is used in the production of high-performance chips for smartphones, cars and medical technology. At our Bochum location, our experienced team is constantly working on improving industrial systems and advancing the technology. Are you ready to be part of this future?

Your mission:

- You will be responsible for day-to-day financial accounting and will ensure that our business transactions are recorded accurately and on time
- You will work with DATEV on a daily basis and handle the account assignment and booking of documents
- You will process incoming invoices and assist with the processing of our outgoing invoices
- You will handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank accounting
- You’ll keep track of our open items and assist with payment processing
- You’ll help prepare and finalize monthly and annual financial statements
- You’ll work closely with our tax advisor and other external partners
- You’ll help further professionalize and automate our finance and accounting processes as the company grows

What you should bring to the team:

- A completed commercial apprenticeship, e.g., as a tax clerk, financial accountant, or similar, is a plus
- Professional experience in financial accounting
- Excellent knowledge of day-to-day bookkeeping
- Experience with DATEV
- Proficiency with MS Office and common finance tools
- A meticulous, structured, and reliable work style
- Enjoyment of taking on responsibility and driving projects forward independently
- Good communication skills in German and English and a pragmatic, hands-on mindset
- You feel at home in a dynamic startup environment and are eager to actively help build structures

Why join us?
Innovation, openness, and curiosity are at the heart of our culture — and we’re always looking for fresh perspectives.

As the leading company in the field of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff members. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.

CGM Leverages AI: We’re looking for people who feel the power of AI in the e-health environment, who want to help shape change, and who are driven by a curious passion to see how technology can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better.

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference - for a world where knowledge saves lives!

Are you passionate about groundbreaking products? Do you have the talent to turn ideas into real, valuable solutions-while always keeping the bigger picture in mind? Then we’d love to meet you!

You take end-to-end accountability for a large, distributed engineering organization that owns our ambulatory SaaS solutions and the shared framework modules used across all AIS DE products.

You co-define and drive the strategic product-technology roadmap for our cloud-based ambulatory portfolio in close collaboration with the executive leadership team.

You ensure that healthcare regulatory requirements-including medical device regulations, audits, and compliance-are rigorously embedded into product development, delivery, and operations.

You lead senior leaders and cross-functional teams, continuously increasing scalability, quality, AI maturity, and innovation velocity across products and platforms.

You represent the domain internally and externally, build strong executive-level stakeholder relationships, and position CGM as a leading SaaS provider in the Health-IT market.

Long-standing leadership experience at Director / VP / CTO level in SaaS product development, ideally with responsibility for large, distributed engineering organizations and complex product portfolios.

Exceptional academic background with a completed university degree and excellent grades, preferably in computer science, medical informatics, engineering, or a comparable technical field.

Deep expertise in cloud architectures and SaaS platforms, including modern DevOps practices and reliability engineering; hands-on experience with healthcare regulations (medical devices, audits, certifications) is a strong advantage.

Proven track record of driving AI adoption in engineering organizations, ideally with first-hand familiarity of Claude Code or comparable agentic coding tools (agents, skills, and workflows) and experience shaping AI pipelines, harnesses, and context engineering at organizational scale.

Excellent English and very good German, a strategic and entrepreneurial mindset, strong execution focus, outstanding leadership and communication skills, and the ability to guide complex organizations through transformation while staying clearly aligned with our healthcare purpose.

Mobile work: Work flexibly on the move two days a week and on site three days a week.

Attractive locations: In addition to fully equipped workplaces, regular events such as summer parties and Christmas parties await you at our locations.

Development: Our in-house academy and our portfolio of external cooperation partners will support you in your further development.

Health: Health is a valuable asset for us. Our in-house canteen offers a selection of tasty and healthy dishes every day, and we welcome you to our fully equipped fitness center for weekly courses (online & offline).

More is always possible: The kindergarten on our CGM campus in Koblenz helps our employees to organize their working day even more flexibly. We also offer corporate benefits, the option of a job bike, a company pension scheme, and much more.

Diversity is part of CGM! We look forward to receiving your application regardles...

TUD Dresden University of Technology, as a University of Excellence, is one of the leading and most dynamic research institutions in Germany.

The new Center for Synergy of Systems (SynoSys) develops transdisciplinary approaches and methods in the fields of network science, data science and citizen science in order to conduct integrative research into complex phenomena at the interfaces between biomedicine, social sciences and life sciences. SynoSys will contribute to the emergence of a scientific vision for healthy human development in which physical and mental health are collectively considered in an increasingly digital and networked social and physical environment. As part of SynoSys the Research Group Computational Social Science is focused on the societal impact of digitalization. The group aims to better understand the dynamics of the complex dissemination of information online and its impact on culture, political behavior and democracy. We employ a broad set of methods, spanning agent-based modeling, time-series analysis, network science and natural language processing, to behavioral experiments in the lab and in the field. Data sources are diverse, either collected from online platforms, recruited participants or data donation approaches. To cover this spectrum, we aim for an inherent transdisciplinary approach and methodological innovation.
For TUD diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.

(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E13 TV-L)

starting at the earliest possible date. The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). The project will include scientific research and collaboration with the Institute of International Law, Intellectual Property and Technology Law at TUD to draft applications for accessing research data under the Digital Services Act Article 40. The core task will be to analyze the resulting data sets, focusing on the causal inference of algorithmic influence on content dynamics and offline outcomes. Other tasks include writing of scientific publications for relevant Journals, conducting detailed literature searches, participating in professional conferences, presenting the research and its projects.
